purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script.

coverage.note: All four are the current BambooHR careers SPA (<sub>.bamboohr.com/careers/<id>). The application is an in-page card: the 'Apply for This Job' button only flips React state (currentCard=application); bridge coordinate clicks and Enter did NOT trigger it, but the element's own .click() did. /careers/<id>/apply is a 404. Select menus (State/Country/Highest Education) never opened under click, keyboard or synthetic mousedown, so those option lists are unobserved.

observed_samples.entry: element.click() on button[data-bi-id=careers-site-apply-button]; same URL, form#job-application-form appears
observed_samples.option_lists_captured: none (State, Country, Highest Education Obtained menus did not open)
observed_samples.note: re-observed with extract_form.js v4 (nearest_heading_before + ancestor_context per control)

observed_samples.option_lists_captured: radio groups captured statically; State menu did not open

page_shape.captcha_widget: Google reCAPTCHA v2 (sitekey 6LfZ4KEs... identical across employers); hidden textarea#g-recaptcha-response
page_shape.honeypot: input#nickname_hpcsaf name=nickname_hpcsaf labelled 'Please leave this field blank' placeholder 'Enter your text here' — MUST NOT be filled
page_shape.apply_entry: button[data-bi-id=careers-site-apply-button] 'Apply for This Job' (React state flip, no navigation)

control_families.text: input[type=text] with id=name (firstName,lastName,email,phone,desiredPay,websiteUrl,linkedinUrl,referredBy,educationInstitutionName) or Fabric ids (FabricTextField-<n>) for address/city/zip (name streetAddress.value/city.value/zip.value). Label via <label for>; required shown only as trailing ' *' in label text (no required/aria-required attrs).
control_families.select: button[aria-haspopup=true][aria-label='<Label> <current value>'] (Fabric/MUI select) with hidden native <select> (1 option) — labels: 'State –Select–', 'Country United States' (default United States, has 'Clear Selection' button), 'Highest Education Obtained –Select–'. Menus not observed.
control_families.file: button 'Choose File*' + hidden input[type=file][aria-label=file-input] accept=.pdf,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.csv,.jpg,.jpeg,.tif,.tiff,.gif,.png,.bmp,.txt,.rtf; Resume required=true (native), Cover Letter optional. DISAMBIGUATION (re-observed 2026-09-24T00:00:19Z with extractor v4): the file input has no label; its ancestor_context chain reads ['Choose File* No file selected','Resume*'] for the resume and ['Choose File No file selected','Cover Letter'] for the cover letter. nearest_heading_before is just '*' (split label span) — use ancestor_context/preceding button text.
control_families.date: input placeholder mm/dd/yyyy 'Date Available' plus button aria-label 'Pick a date.' (dialog).
control_families.radiogroup: fieldset[aria-required] > legend '<question> *' > div[role=radiogroup] > input[type=radio] name=customQuestionAnswers.yes_no_<n> value Yes|No.
control_families.textarea: textarea id/name=customQuestionAnswers.long_<n> labelled by the full question text (label for=id); a second unlabeled textarea sits beside each (Fabric internal). Required shown as ' *' at end of label.
control_families.submit: button[type=submit] 'Submit Application' (outside the form element in DOM order; form_index null). STOP BOUNDARY.

blockers.detail: Bridge click/Enter did not flip the card; only element.click() worked. Runtime must use a DOM-level click or the user must click.
Fabric select buttons did not open via click, ArrowDown, or synthetic mousedown within 1.5s.
Hidden 'Please leave this field blank' input; filling it will likely flag the submission as spam.

runtime_observations: Question ids are customQuestionAnswers.<type>_<n> where type is long|yes_no (others likely short|select).
Required-ness only via trailing ' *' in label/legend text, except native required on the resume file input and aria-required on fieldsets.
document.title is useless for identity; use h3 + subdomain.

inferred.select_option_inference: State is the US state list; Country the ISO country list; Highest Education likely High School/Associate/Bachelor's/Master's/Doctorate. UNVERIFIED.
inferred.eeo_inference: No EEO/veteran/disability block observed in four samples; BambooHR may add one per employer setting.

provider_hint.for_jev: BambooHR careers: single in-page form. Required = label ends with ' *'. Never touch the honeypot 'Please leave this field blank'. Custom questions are Yes/No radiogroups (customQuestionAnswers.yes_no_N) or long textareas (customQuestionAnswers.long_N) whose label is the full question; several are hard narratives demanding specifics (spend, tools, compliance). reCAPTCHA is human. Stop at 'Submit Application'.
option_choice_from_verified_facts: located in / willing to relocate to city

edge_cases: 'Link to This Job' text field inside the page has a prefilled value (the job URL) — not candidate data.
Two textareas per long question: the labelled one carries the id/name; the sibling unlabeled textarea is a Fabric mirror.
